title: Alter and Coleman: a framework, not a verdict on whether consciousness is fundamental

statements.text: Russellian monism does not set out to settle whether consciousness is a fundamental component of the universe. It offers a framework in which that question and others can be addressed, one that neither traditional physicalism nor traditional dualism provides.

sources.quote: Russellian monism does not purport to settle whether consciousness is a fundamental component of the universe.
